name: pwa-nativo
desc: Claude Code plugin for PWAs that feel native on phones and desktops
author: candiani
typing: PWAs that feel native on phones and desktops
Create, convert, audit, notify and optimize
32-rule auditor with file and line, no network
Next.js, Vite, React, Supabase and Web Push
tagline: From website to installable app, with notifications that arrive and an app layout on both screens.
pitch: **pwa-nativo** packs into one plugin what turned precodiesel.com.br into an app: correct manifest and icons, a service worker that opens offline, per-platform install, notifications tested on the spot, and a shell with a dock on the phone and a side panel on the desktop.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are trademarks of Anthropic.

what.product: Claude Code plugin: create, convert, audit, notify and optimize PWAs
what.layers: manifest · service worker · install · notifications · native shell · data · verification
what.auditor: 32 rules, TOON output, per-file sha1 cache, never executes audited code
what.templates: 17 files: sw.js, browser core, React, Next, Vite, CSS, Supabase, generators
what.notifications: dependency-free VAPID, test on enable, dispatcher that only notifies what changed
what.desktop: side panel from 768 px, wide screenshots, window-controls-overlay
